observation: The previous cycle's visible failure was cycle detection, but audit revealed a more serious artifact drift: the ZIP contained a placeholder Python module while tests exercised notebook-only code.
prior_belief: Fixing cycle reachability would be sufficient.
intervention: Used TDD to rebuild the packaged API, added path-preserving cycle/transitive analysis, policy-configurable anomaly severity, randomized oracle comparison, input immutability checks, and clean-package execution verification.
measured_outcome: 13/13 local tests passed before packaging; clean-package verification is recorded separately in test_report.json after ZIP extraction.
evidence_quality: Strong local deterministic/adversarial evidence; no authenticated real sibling manifests; exact Deep Research unavailable this cycle.
confidence_delta: High increase in packaging/reproduction confidence; moderate increase in algorithm confidence; no increase in manifest-authenticity confidence.
failure_or_surprise: Artifact/runtime mismatch was more severe than the known test failure.
reusable_lesson: Verification must execute the shipped artifact from a clean extraction, not merely the in-memory/notebook implementation.
invalidated_assumption: A passing notebook harness implies the packaged capability is runnable.
retry_condition: When authenticated real manifests are available or a new graph collision class is proposed.
expiration_revalidation_condition: Any detector API, manifest schema, dependency policy, or packaging process change.
next_experiment: Authenticated manifest provenance plus Evaluator Fabric integration contract.
